title: Evaluate every question you ask
principle: Luke W’s public form organization rule: each question costs completion. Keep, cut, postpone, or explain—speak with one voice. Use this before AI generates a ‘comprehensive’ intake form.
procedure: List every proposed field as a question.
Merge duplicate asks; align voice across stakeholders.
examplePrompts:
Run evaluate-every-question (Luke W):
For each field: keep | cut | postpone | explain why we ask.
Speak with one product voice.
Return the triage table before any UI.
Stakeholders want 20 fields. Cut to the minimum that unlocks the first successful outcome.
promptWhy: Triage before UI stops comprehensive-by-default AI forms.
Explain tag surfaces creepy asks early.
tips: Public Web Form Design practices from lukew.com materials.
